# Barby InfoManager - Setup Instructions

## Project Overview
Python-based BI Dashboard using Dash and Plotly for sales and e-commerce analytics.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Clarify Project Requirements
- [x] Scaffold the Project  
- [ ] Customize the Project
- [ ] Install Required Extensions
- [ ] Compile the Project
- [ ] Create and Run Task
- [ ] Launch the Project
- [ ] Ensure Documentation is Complete

## Dependencies
- dash==2.14.1
- plotly==5.17.0
- pandas==2.1.1
- numpy==1.24.3
- gunicorn==21.2.0

## Running the Application
```bash
python src/app.py
```

Access at: `http://localhost:8050`
